defects.description: Glossary term 'Finding' should be translated as 'Вывод', but 'результаты' was used.
The term 'safe value' is mistranslated as 'безопасного замечания' (safe remark/note) instead of 'безопасного значения'.
The term 'applied defaults' is mistranslated as 'применённые замечания по умолчанию' (applied remarks by default) instead of 'значения по умолчанию'.

The phrase 'explicitly set, never inferred' is mistranslated as 'явно задача, никогда не выводится', which changes the meaning entirely (it suggests 'explicitly a task' and 'never outputted' rather than 'explicitly set' and 'never inferred').
